product_summary: Website (ptcdrivelines.com, ISO 9001:2015, Chennai, 'since 2007') lists a concrete driveline component range: Spider Assembly, Propeller Shaft / Drive Shaft, Cross Bearing, Universal Joint, Cardan Shaft, Yoke Assembly, Output Shaft, Driveline Coupling, Wheel Bolt, Wheel Nut, Cap Screw / 12-Point Bolt, Wheel Washer & Wheel Stud, plus a 'Locomotive' line and 'Custom Manufacturing'. Positioning: maintenance-free / self-lubricating replacement driveline parts for Komatsu, CAT, BEML and Volvo mining, earthmoving and construction machinery (dump/haul trucks, articulated dump trucks, wheel loaders, dozers, motor graders, diesel locomotives).
role_hint: manufacturer (self-declared 'we manufacture'; ISO 9001:2015 claimed). No independent confirmation of own plant vs. trading of OEM-referenced spares — the site markets 'Komatsu/CAT/BEML/Volvo spare parts' by brand and model, which is also a trader pattern. Treat as manufacturer_trader until verified.
comment: HS mapping: declared 848390 is a good fit for the driveline parts core (spider assembly, cross bearing, universal joint, yoke assembly = parts of transmission shafts/couplings, 8483.90), and 870840 is plausible only for gearbox-related items for the off-highway machines named. However the declared pair is incomplete and partly mis-aimed: (1) the flagship items — propeller/drive shafts, cardan shafts, output shafts, driveline couplings — are finished shafts/couplings under 8483.60, not parts under 8483.90; (2) a whole fastener line (wheel bolt, wheel nut, cap screw/12-point bolt, wheel washer, wheel stud) is missing from the declaration and belongs to 7318.15/7318.16/7318.22; (3) the 'Locomotive' line (parts of railway locomotives, ch. 86) is not covered by either declared code. Industry claimed as 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' is a misclassification: the company is an automotive/off-highway driveline component maker serving mining end-users, not a metals/mining producer — the mining reference is only the end-use sector of its customers. All product data is from the company's own website catalogue; no customs line was available to this researcher, so every product/HS line above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: company is retained, declared codes corrected/extended to 8483.60, 8483.90, 7318.15, 7318.16, 7318.22, with 8708.40 kept conditionally and ch. 86 flagged for the locomotive line. Legal entity name 'VELLAICHAMY CHANDRAMOHAN' and PAN/state not verified here (out of scope).
